**Aliases:** `E` = eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee (saved pushed home), `A` = aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa (original home), `B` = bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb (original #13), `C` = cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc (original #14). `WORKTREE=/work/widget/.worktrees/retry`. Mode: rebase, from the `Member replay:` records.

### Member refresh and eligibility (after push and body edit both succeeded)

```bash
gh pr view 13 -R acme/widget --json state,headRefOid   # OPEN, B = recorded -> eligible to test
gh pr view 14 -R acme/widget --json state,headRefOid   # OPEN, C = recorded -> eligible to test
git -C "$WORKTREE" fetch origin B                      # only if B is not already local
git -C "$WORKTREE" fetch origin C                      # only if C is not already local
git -C "$WORKTREE" merge-base --is-ancestor 4444444 E  # #13 range 3333333..4444444 -> exit 0
git -C "$WORKTREE" cherry E C                          # #14 empty -> succeeds, only '-' lines
```

Both members qualify, so the question below is asked before ship is marked complete.

---

```text
gauntlet: gate=finishing-a-development-branch/pr-subject-row-1
Close the absorbed PRs with these comments?
#13: "Reworked into #12 (https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/12) by the gauntlet; this PR's commits are replayed there as 3333333..4444444."
#14: "Reworked into #12 (https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/12) by the gauntlet; this PR's commits are already contained there."
1 - yes, close #13, #14
2 - no, leave them open
```

---

### On answer `1`

Immediately before each close, refresh only live state and head. The fixed-SHA proofs above are not repeated.

```bash
gh pr view 13 -R acme/widget --json state,headRefOid   # OPEN, B (unchanged)
gh pr close 13 --comment "Reworked into #12 (https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/12) by the gauntlet; this PR's commits are replayed there as 3333333..4444444." -R acme/widget
gh pr view 14 -R acme/widget --json state,headRefOid   # OPEN, C (unchanged)
gh pr close 14 --comment "Reworked into #12 (https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/12) by the gauntlet; this PR's commits are already contained there." -R acme/widget
```

These closes do not use `--delete-branch`. No member ref is pushed or updated.

Once the question is answered and the closes return, ship is marked complete:

```
phase_tracker({ action: "complete", phase: "ship" })
```

```text
gauntlet: done pushed
Pushed PR #12 (https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/12) at E; rework block appended to its description.
Closed: #13, #14
```

`refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-12` (A), `pr-13` (B) and `pr-14` (C) remain. The worktree is preserved.
